items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I played with Charlie Crith quite often when I was up there.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. He married his sister. Sister. Margaret.

Margaret. Margaret. Margaret of Margaret. That's what he stopped saying in St. Louis. I played with Charlie Crith quite often when I was up there. He used to play with those boys at the show for clubs sometimes.
How did Charlie Crith play? I heard he was a good blues player. Was he good on everything or just blues? How did he sound like? Well, he is good. He's a good trumpet.
